findings.text: s40 requires "every run of that section that has delivered or been promoted has its head reachable from the primary branch", but the shipped check for exactly this fact is `_request_state` in `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3382-3396`, which reads the run's ledger row and tests its `promoted_revision` as an ancestor of HEAD in the project's registered checkout — and §8 of this same plan (`plan.html:80`, declared done) states it "never names a branch, so a project whose primary branch is develop is answered the same way"; s40 reintroduces a branch-naming test beside it, so a worker can implement either and the two disagree for any project whose primary branch is not the checkout's current branch, and for a promoted run whose `promoted_revision` is its base

findings.reason: two cases that read as "promotion status decides" would have the node implement the wrong predicate, and a hand-merged run would then hold the queue indefinitely.
findings.text: the fourth case holds the request while the upstream run is "delivered and unpromoted", but it does not state that run's head is off the primary branch; a run merged onto the branch without being promoted (a hand merge, or a reviewed change landed by the coordinator) satisfies the Deliverable's reachability rule and should release, yet as written the case invites a gate on promotion status instead of reachability, and the third case ("promotes the upstream run without merging it") covers the converse shape

findings.reason: without a rule and a case for a discarded delivered run, the node can deadlock the queue on the very state s37 exists to clean up, and the fourth case asserts the opposite treatment for the same "delivered, will never land" shape.
findings.text: s40's rule ("no run of it is unlanded") has no release path for a delivered run that is subsequently discarded or superseded: its head will never reach the primary branch, so under the stated rule the section's waiters wait forever, while the shipped `_request_state` treats exactly that shape as ABANDONED (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3339-3341`, `_discarded(run_id)`), and s40's own carve-out accepts that a section done with no run releases
